title: Pairwise cocycle exponent and scalar normalization
statement: Let k be a field, r>=3, and let overlap units satisfy the triple-overlap cocycle equation. Given pairwise Laurent exponents and scalar coefficients on distinct overlaps, the cocycle equation yields one common integer exponent and chart units satisfying the off-diagonal normalization equation.

proof.text: Work on the open T where all homogeneous coordinates are invertible. Use the already proved source theorem ProjectiveSpace.bijective_sum_awayMonomial (TwistSections) with the full coordinate set: finite sums of degree-zero Laurent monomials have unique coefficients. The private torus_monomial_injective helper specializes its injectivity to two nonzero scalar monomials. Compute the restriction of x_i/x_j using map_ratio, with denominator the product of all coordinates and numerator x_i times the product excluding j. Its exponent vector is delta_i-delta_j. The proved awayMonomial multiplication and power identities in LineDifferentials give exponent d(delta_i-delta_j) for every integer d, including negative d. Structural constants commute with restriction.

Restrict the supplied pairwise expansions and cocycle equation to T for three distinct indices i,j,l. Monomial injectivity gives e_ij(delta_i-delta_j)+e_jl(delta_j-delta_l)=e_il(delta_i-delta_l) and c_ij*c_jl=c_il. Evaluate the exponent equality at i and l to get e_ij=e_jl=e_il. This uses the given expansions as hypotheses; the existence theorem exists_pairwise_laurent_unit_expansion is not applied. Its module supplies only the concrete structural constant units.

Fix b=0 and q=1 and put d=e_bq. Because r>=3, among 0,1,2 there is an index different from any given two. The triple equalities first imply constancy within a row and then e_ij=e_ji; comparison with row b therefore gives e_ij=d for every distinct pair. Apply the scalar triple identity to (i,j,l) and (j,i,l) and cancel c_il to obtain c_ij*c_ji=1. Set a_b=1 and a_i=c_ib inverse for i different from b. For i=b use the reverse-pair identity, for j=b use inverse cancellation, and otherwise use c_ij*c_jb=c_ib; in all cases a_i*c_ij=a_j.

Regard the explicit scalar units a_i as standardOpenConstUnit on the charts. Their restrictions are the same structural constants on the overlap. Substitute hpair, e_ij=d and a_i*c_ij=a_j; multiplicativity of the structural map and commutativity give exactly the required normalization equation on every distinct overlap.
